description_en: Detects stack-related operation risks and returns missing permissions and the causes of the risks
description_zh: 检测进行资源栈操作可能涉及的风险，并返回风险原因或缺失项
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-stack-operation-risks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --operation-type DeleteStack --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-ram-role-name test-role --retain-all-resources false --retain-resources instance --template-body '{"ROSTemplateFormatVersion":"2015-09-01"}' --template-url oss://ros-template/demo --template-id 5ecd1e10-b0e9-4389-a565-e4c15efc0000 --template-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStackOperationRisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the operation of which you want to detect risks. Valid values:

DeleteStack: detects high risks that may arise in resources when you delete a stack.

CreateStack: detects the missing permissions when you fail to create a stack
parameters.help_zh:
需要检测的操作类型。
取值：

DeleteStack：检测删除资源栈操作涉及的高风险资源。

CreateStack：创建资源栈操作可能出现的创建失败的风险，仅支持检测调用者可能缺失的权限
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求的幂等性。该值由客户端生成，并且必须是全局唯一的。 
长度不超过64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。 
更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM role.

If you specify a RAM role, ROS creates stacks based on the permissions that are granted to the RAM role and uses the credentials of the RAM role to call the API operations of Alibaba Cloud services.

If you do not specify a RAM role, ROS creates stacks based on the permissions of your Alibaba Cloud account.

The name of the RAM role can be up to 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色名称。

如果指定RAM角色，ROS将根据RAM角色的权限创建资源栈，使用角色的凭证代表用户进行接口调用。  

如果不指定RAM角色，ROS将使用当前账号相关权限创建资源栈。

RAM角色名称最大长度为64个字节
parameters.name: ram_role_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain all resources in the stack. Valid values:

true

false (default)

This parameter takes effect only if you set OperationType to DeleteStack
parameters.help_zh:
是否保留该资源栈下的所有资源。
取值：  

true：保留。  

false（默认值）：不保留。  
  

当OperationType取值为DeleteStack时该参数有效
parameters.name: retain_all_resources

parameters.help_en:
The list of resources to retain.

This parameter takes effect only if you set OperationType to DeleteStack
parameters.help_zh:
需要保留资源的列表。  
当OperationType取值为DeleteStack时，该参数有效
parameters.name: retain_resources

parameters.help_en:
The structure that contains the template body. The template body must be 1 to 524,288 bytes in length. If the length of the template body exceeds the upper limit, we recommend that you add parameters to the HTTP POST request body to prevent request failures caused by excessively long URLs.

You must and can specify only one of the following parameters: TemplateBody, TemplateURL, TemplateId, and TemplateScratchId
parameters.help_zh:
模板主体的结构。长度为1~524,288个字节。如果长度较长，则建议通过HTTP POST+Body Param的方式，将参数放在请求体中进行传递，避免因URL过长而导致请求失败。 
您必须且仅能指定TemplateBody、TemplateURL、TemplateId或TemplateScratchId其中一个参数
parameters.name: template_body

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the file that contains the template body. The URL must point to a template that is located on an HTTP or HTTPS web server or in an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket, such as oss\://ros/stack-policy/demo and oss\://ros/stack-policy/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou. The template body can be up to 524,288 bytes in length. If you do not specify RegionId in the URL, the region ID of the stack is used.

You must specify one of TemplateBody, TemplateURL, TemplateId, and TemplateScratchId
parameters.help_zh:
包含模板主体的文件的位置。URL必须指向位于Web服务器（HTTP或HTTPS）或阿里云OSS存储空间（例如：oss://ros/stack-policy/demo、oss://ros/stack-policy/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou）中的模板，模板的最大长度为524,288个字节。如未指定OSS地域，默认与RegionId取值相同。

您必须且仅能指定TemplateBody、TemplateURL、TemplateId或TemplateScratchId其中一个参数
parameters.name: template_url

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the template. This parameter applies to shared and private templates.

You must specify one of TemplateBody, TemplateURL, TemplateId, and TemplateScratchId
parameters.help_zh:
模板ID。支持共享模板和私有模板。

您必须且仅能指定TemplateBody、TemplateURL、TemplateId或TemplateScratchId其中一个参数
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the template.

This parameter takes effect only if you specify TemplateId
parameters.help_zh:
模板版本。

当您指定TemplateId时，本参数才生效
parameters.name: template_version
